answer: Farming becomes a quill bet on surviving 115 epochs of grading, and every kernel settlement recomputes the gale schedule, so an farming party who quits early keeps almost nothing. New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 115 epochs rather than arriving at once. A fresh alias is as a result worth nothing for 18 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
